faqs.question: How long does a typical Graphic Design engagement take?
faqs.answer: Campaign or collateral packs often turn around in 1–3 weeks. Larger brand application systems take 3–6 weeks.

faqs.question: Do you work with existing teams and tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. We adopt your brand kit and collaborate with marketers who need rapid, on-brand assets.

faqs.question: How do you measure success?
faqs.answer: On-brand consistency, production speed, stakeholder approval cycles, and performance of assets in live campaigns when measurable.

faqs.question: What assets can you produce?
faqs.answer: Social creatives, ad sets, pitch decks, one-pagers, event graphics, email headers, and presentation systems.

faqs.question: Do you need a brand guide first?
faqs.answer: Ideal but not required. We can extract interim rules from existing materials, then formalize if needed.

faqs.question: How many revision rounds?
faqs.answer: Scoped clearly per project — typically two structured rounds after the first concept direction is chosen.

faqs.question: Can you match paid media sizes quickly?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build templates so resizing for Meta/Google/LinkedIn placements stays efficient.

faqs.question: Static and motion?
faqs.answer: Static by default; simple motion/GIFs available. Full video is handled by our video production service.

faqs.question: How do we get started?
faqs.answer: Share brief, audience, and deadlines. We confirm deliverables, formats, and a production calendar.

faqs.question: Who designs the assets?
faqs.answer: Graphic designers with art direction for multi-asset campaigns so everything feels like one system.
